seoTitle: Sitemap Lastmod Timeline and Staleness Report
metaDescription: Chart lastmod dates per day, month or year, spot single-day spikes and see which folders are stale. Free, runs locally.
intro: Plots how many URLs were modified in each period and shows staleness by folder.
why:
A spike on one day often means the CMS rewrites every date on deploy. A folder whose newest date is two years old may be dead content.

The tool buckets valid lastmod values, flags a day holding half or more of the URLs, and compares folders. Set the reference date to repeat a report on a saved file.
howTo: Pick day, month or year buckets, or leave auto.
Read the chart and the folder table.
